sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: In providing its features, the Service collects and stores the following information.
list: Account information: email address, display name, password (stored in hashed form), and date of creation
Profile information: avatar image and badge emoji

Content information: faces (name, emoji, description, image, visibility settings), posts (seeds: body text, attached images, links between posts, creation date, and associated face), and uploaded files and their metadata (file name, type, size, owner, and visibility)
Usage information: subscription relationships, notifications, and online status (presence)
Authentication information: access tokens (JWT) and refresh tokens (issuance time, generation identifier, and enabled/disabled status)

sections.heading: 2. Purposes of Use
list: Providing the Service, authenticating users, and controlling access
Providing features for displaying, storing, and searching content such as posts and faces
Providing features such as subscriptions, notifications, and online status
Preventing misuse and improving the quality of the Service

sections.heading: 3. Provision to Third Parties
paragraphs: Except as provided by laws and regulations, the Operator will not provide personal information to third parties without obtaining the individual's prior consent.

sections.heading: 4. Use of Cookies and Tokens
paragraphs: The Service uses mechanisms such as tokens (access tokens / refresh tokens) to maintain login status and perform authentication.

sections.heading: 5. Security Measures
list: Passwords are stored in hashed form.
In production-equivalent environments, communications are encrypted using HTTPS.
Private faces, posts, and files are displayed and delivered only after access permissions have been verified.

sections.heading: 6. Retention Period and Deletion
paragraphs: Collected information is retained to the extent necessary to achieve the purposes of use, and information that becomes unnecessary, such as through account deletion, is promptly deleted.

sections.heading: 7. Requests for Disclosure, Correction, Deletion, etc.
paragraphs: Users may request the disclosure, correction, deletion, or other handling of their own personal information. For details of the procedure, please contact the Operator's inquiry desk.

sections.heading: 8. Revisions to This Policy
paragraphs: This Policy may be changed as necessary. The revised content applies from the time it is posted on the Service.
